title: Umami Korean Noodle Soup Sujebi
description: A comforting, molten, and nostalgic Korean dish from Busan featuring ancho chilies, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine ancho chilies, garlic, gochujang, and 2 tablespoons of water. Bring to a simmer and let reduce until thick and almost molten.
Add gochugaru, sugar, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
In a separate saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and add the flour to make a roux, stirring constantly until it lightly browns.
Slowly add water, whisking constantly to avoid lumps, and cook until the sauce thickens and emulsifies.
Add beef broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Add the noodles to the saucepan and cook until just tender, about 3-5 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In a separate saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and add crushed sesame seeds and stir-fry until lightly browned.
Add the scallions and stir-fry until wilted. Set aside.
To assemble the sujebi, place noodles in a bowl and top with the spicy sauce, sesame seeds and scallions, and finally sprinkle anchovy paste on top.
